content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Kalyani Project Associate-I (Biological Sciences)
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Kalyani is a Statutory Body under the Aegis of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, GoI, located at NH-34 Connector, Basantapur, Saguna, Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal - 741245. The selected candidate shall be employed under the Broad Institute – National Institutes of Health (NIH), USA funded research project titled “Asian Bipolar Genetics Network (A-BIG-NET)”, and NOT directly under AIIMS Kalyani.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I (Biological Sciences) post under the A-BIG-NET project. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualifications, age limits, and experience criteria specified for the post. Four-year Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Biological Sciences from a recognised university, or equivalent. Must have qualified the National Eligibility Test (CSIR-UGC NET)/GATE or equivalent. At least one year of experience of working in a research project in a recognised institute. Publications in indexed journals in the relevant field. The upper age limit is 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive ₹37,000/- per month + HRA (as applicable). No allowances or facilities other than the consolidated emoluments shall be admissible. The above post is to be filled purely on a contractual basis for a period of 6 months or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier, as per approval from the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Project Associate-I (Biological Sciences) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work under Dr. Aniruddha Basu, Additional Professor and Site Principal Investigator, Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS Kalyani, for the Broad Institute – National Institutes of Health (NIH), USA funded research project titled “Asian Bipolar Genetics Network (A-BIG-NET)”.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Kalyani Project Associate-I (Biological Sciences)
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may apply in the attached proforma (Annexure). Fill in the application form completely with all required details. Attach self-attested copies of certificates of age, qualifications, and experience. Email the filled-in application form, along with self-attested copies of certificates of age, qualifications and experience, to [email protected] by 30.10.2026 5pm. Attend the walk-in interview on 31.10.2026 from 9:00 AM at the Psychiatry IPD, Dhanvantari Building, AIIMS Kalyani.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligibility will be decided on the basis of document verification by the Selection Committee and the competent authority. The walk-in interview will be held on 31.10.2026 from 9:00 AM at the Psychiatry IPD, Dhanvantari Building, AIIMS Kalyani. No candidate will be allowed to report after 9:30 AM. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
